purpose: Teach: アテネ/アーキテクチャ/メーリングリスト/ファイナンス/エステ/ゲリラ/アイヌ/名乗る

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアテネの遺跡の写真集、見せてくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed me a beautiful photo collection of the ruins in Athens.
lines.style: Warm, sharing-news tone. Gentle pace. Mother's voice — conversational, inviting Sho into something Dad found interesting. Slight upturn at the end, like offering him a gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お家のアーキテクチャって、何のこと?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, slightly uncertain. Soft voice — asking carefully, not demanding. Pause before the question, like he's been turning the words over in his mind.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママはお仕事のメーリングリストを管理しているのよ
lines.en: Well, sweetheart, at work I manage the mailing list for my team.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Explaining without talking down. Steady pace — she's answering his question directly, trusting he can follow. Slight pride in her competence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが、お家のファイナンス、教えてくれるんだって
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa said he's going to teach me about managing the household finances.
lines.style: Brightening — this is exciting news. Eager lift in the voice. Quick pace, like he can't wait to tell her. Respect in the way he says 'Grandpa,' like this is serious and important.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエステに行くって言ってたわよ
lines.en: Oh, and your dad mentioned he's going to a spa appointment later.
lines.style: Casual aside, almost offhand. Short breath — it's not the main point. Slight lilt, acknowledging this is a small domestic detail. Mother's voice, just passing along information.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ゲリラ豪雨で、傘なくしちゃった
lines.en: Mom, I lost my umbrella in that sudden downpour.
lines.style: Small, rueful laugh underneath. Self-aware — he knows this is partly his own carelessness. Light tone, trying not to make it a big deal. Quiet at the end, waiting for her reaction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、アイヌの伝統工芸品を集めてらっしゃるそうよ
lines.en: Your dad's been collecting traditional Ainu crafts, apparently.
lines.style: Musing tone — sharing something she's learned about him. Slower pace, like she's reflecting on the tidbit. Warm, slightly amused, as if Dad's hobby interests her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、いつも自分から名乗るようにしてるよ, 本気で
lines.en: Mom, I'm always making sure to introduce myself first when I meet someone — I'm really trying.
lines.style: Sincere and earnest. Slight pride underneath. Deliberate pace — he's announcing something he's working on, something he cares about. Wants her to notice the effort.
